T: Leave the camera running. Leave the lights off.
D: A young couple set up a video camera to record what's happening in their house at night.
P: Serve the snacks when the camera is set up on the tripod for the first night.
S: up again watching the camera footage
Golden toasted cheese sandwiches with a little Dijon, cut into soldiers. Butter the outsides of 8 slices of bread.
the footprints in the powder on the hallway floor
Flatbread dough rolled into long ovals, dusted with flour and pressed with toes made of olive halves, baked at 230C for 6 minutes. Hummus alongside.
Lavash cut into a big rectangle, brushed with oil, letters and numbers stencilled on with smoked paprika, baked crisp at 180C. Whipped feta to dip.
M: eating in front of the footage
Pepperoni and mushroom pizza on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, left in the box on the bed while you rewatch the tape.
the couple's house in San Diego
White fish in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm tortillas with shredded cabbage, lime crema and pico de gallo.
W: Dark chocolate custard of cream, milk, yolks and sugar baked in small cups in a water bath at 150C for 30 minutes, chilled until set.
K: staying up to check the tape
Strong plunger coffee, 60g to a litre, steeped 4 minutes, poured into big mugs.

s.note: up again watching the camera footage
s.how: Butter the outsides of 8 slices of bread. Fill 4 sandwiches with 200g grated cheddar and a thin spread of Dijon and toast in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side. Cut into strips.
Brush a large lavash with oil. Stencil letters and numbers on with smoked paprika and bake at 180C until crisp. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt to dip. Don't ask it anything.

m.note: eating in front of the footage
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with 200g crushed tomatoes and top with 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and 150g sliced mushrooms. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes. Rewatch the tape.

w.how: Warm 300ml cream and 200ml milk, pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate and stir smooth. Whisk 4 yolks with 60g sugar and combine. Pour into 4 small cups and bake in a water bath at 150C for 30 minutes. Chill until set.

d.note: staying up to check the tape
d.how: Put 60g ground coffee in a plunger with 1L water just off the boil. Steep 4 minutes, plunge and pour into big mugs with milk. Stay awake and keep the camera rolling.
